title: Crown Night: the Lawful Hours
body: No house may take the Old Throne by stealth. Declare your claim with /claim declare at least an hour before a rebellion window, then fight for the throne while it is open. Check /crown for the next window. The first Crown Night will be announced here.

title: Six great houses await
body: Varrow of the Iron Stag, Ashgrove of the White Oak, Corvane of the Black Raven, Dunmere of the Drowned Bell, Halloran of the Ember Hound and Merrin of the Silver Eel. Sign up to claim one before the gates open, or found a house of your own.

title: The Hearth Charter of Ostreval
body: The crown belongs to the seat, not the blood. The monarch rules with a council and limited decrees, the tax is capped, and no captive is held past the ransom-glass. Break an oath if you dare: the Chronicle remembers.
